notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary receive-order attribute-update fan-out. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies object registration and discovery followed by two ordinary attribute updates delivered to two active subscribers in producer order, that the owner receives no loopback reflection, and that object, attribute value, user tag, producing federate, and transportation metadata are preserved. Timestamped delivery, directed interaction, regions/DDM, custom transportation, MOM, save/restore, and provider-private behavior remain outside this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class lookup, publication, active subscription, object registration, ordinary Update Attribute Values, unsubscription, unpublication, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery and ordinary reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ordinary attribute-update fan-out declarations
